sqlReaderQuery.value:
@concat('select fulldate
from 
    eds.eds_ctl ect
inner join 
    eds.date_dim dd
    on 
    ect.',pipeline().parameters.src_sys,'_Date=dd.previous_business_day and dd.business_day_flag=''Y''')

parameters.HashLog_SQL: INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL] SELECT 'CBC01_DID_TRYPRODUCT_DIM_001_20260408' AS FILE_NAME ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS DATE ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS insert_dttm ,'COUNT' METRICS ,'1' SRC ,'1' TGT

EDS_SQL.value: BEGIN TRY UPDATE EDS.DID_TRYPRODUCT_DIM SET [ISLATEST] = 0 ,[SCD_END_DATE] = ( SELECT PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM INNER JOIN ( SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM d360.STG_EDS_DID_TRYPRODUCT_DIM WHERE H = 'D' ) MX_DT_TBL ON DATESK = MX_DT ) FROM EDS.DID_TRYPRODUCT_DIM tgt LEFT JOIN d360.STG_EDS_DID_TRYPRODUCT_DIM src ON src.[PRODUCT_CODE_FMS] = tgt.[PRODUCT_CODE_FMS] AND src.[H] = 'D' WHERE tgt.[ISLATEST] = 1 AND HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', src.[PRODUCT_GROUP_FMS], src.[PRODUCT_CLASSIFICATION_FMS], src.[PRODUCT_DESC_FMS])) <> HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', tgt.[PRODUCT_GROUP_FMS], tgt.[PRODUCT_CLASSIFICATION_FMS], tgt.[PRODUCT_DESC_FMS])); INSERT INTO EDS.DID_TRYPRODUCT_DIM ( [PRODUCT_GROUP_FMS] ,[PRODUCT_CLASSIFICATION_FMS] ,[PRODUCT_CODE_FMS] ,[PRODUCT_DESC_FMS] ,[FILE_NAME] ,[SCD_START_DATE] ,[SCD_END_DATE] ,[ISACTIVE] ,[ISLATEST] ,[BNK_CODE] ,[SOURCE_CODE] ,[INSERT_DTTM] ) SELECT DISTINCT src.[PRODUCT_GROUP_FMS] ,src.[PRODUCT_CLASSIFICATION_FMS] ,src.[PRODUCT_CODE_FMS] ,src.[PRODUCT_DESC_FMS] ,src.[FILE_NAME] ,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(src.[FILE_NAME], 12), 8) AS DATE) AS [SCD_START_DATE] ,CAST('9999-12-31' AS DATE) AS [SCD_END_DATE] ,1 AS [ISACTIVE] ,1 AS [ISLATEST] ,LEFT(src.[FILE_NAME], 5) AS [BNK_CODE] ,'DID' AS [SOURCE_CODE] ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATETIME) FROM d360.STG_EDS_DID_TRYPRODUCT_DIM src WHERE src.[H] = 'D' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM EDS.DID_TRYPRODUCT_DIM tgt WHERE src.[PRODUCT_CODE_FMS] = tgt.[PRODUCT_CODE_FMS] AND HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', src.[PRODUCT_GROUP_FMS], src.[PRODUCT_CLASSIFICATION_FMS], src.[PRODUCT_DESC_FMS])) = HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', tgt.[PRODUCT_GROUP_FMS], tgt.[PRODUCT_CLASSIFICATION_FMS], tgt.[PRODUCT_DESC_FMS])) AND tgt.[ISLATEST] = 1 ); END TRY BEGIN CATCH DECLARE @msg NVARCHAR(2048) = ERROR_MESSAGE(); THROW 51000 ,@msg ,1; END CATCH
